messages:
Olivia (AE): Kickoff for Acme POC. Need to align success criteria, eval prompts, and confirm model fit (context, tool-calls, embeddings/rerank). Tony can join at 11am PT to demo their data shape.
Raj (ML Eng): thanks. quick list of immediate Qs: 1) max context they'd expect? 2) need tool calling to access internal DBs? 3) reranker + embedding use-case or simple semantic search?
Tony (Customer): We have ~5000 docs, avg 1.2k tokens each; long thread summaries are common. Prefer up to 32k context for a single query. Tool calling: yes, we want a pinned connector to internal ticket system (read-only). Rerank: yes — initial semantic match then rerank by domain-specific signals.
Sara (Solutions Eng): got it. Proposed POC phases: week 0: infra + security review; week 1: data ingest + embed store + baseline search; week 2: reranker model + evals (prompt sets); week 3: performance tuning + handoff. Is that timeline ok?
Olivia (AE): timeline ok but Tony asked for cost estimate vs dedicated vs hosted. Tony: any budget constraints?
Tony (Customer): We're evaluating both hosted and dedicated. Prefer hosted first if latency<200ms for most queries; otherwise dedicated for SLA. Budget: looking to keep monthly inference < $10k for POC.
Raj (ML Eng): rough numbers: hosted with 32k context & rerank at our standard mX-large will be ~ $8k-12k/mo depending on query volume. Dedicated reserve could be cheaper for sustained load but needs commitment. I can run sample cost calc if Tony shares expected qps and avg tokens per query.
Sara (Solutions Eng): Action items: - @Raj: cost calc + recommended model variants (32k vs 8k quantized) - @Olivia: send security questionnaire to Tony - @Tony: share sample queries + qps estimate - All: confirm final success criteria (precision@5, latency p95, infra SLOs).
Raj (ML Eng): On model fit: recommending a 32k-capable open model family with tool-calling enabled. For rerank, propose embeddings + lightweight cross-encoder reranker fine-tuned on 500 labeled pairs. If fine-tuning isn’t allowed, we can do a learned reweighting on features (embedding cos sim, recency, ticket-priority).
Olivia (AE): Security note from Tony: data residency requirement in eu-west-1, and they need KMS integration and audit logs.
security-bot: Reminder: for Private deployments we require a signed DPA and network diagram. See https://redwood.example.com/security/requirements
Sara (Solutions Eng): For evals, suggest these metrics: - Success criteria: precision@5 >= 0.75 on curated test set; p95 latency < 300ms (hosted) - Quality: L0 regression tolerance 5% drop vs baseline prompts - Ops: error rate < 1% and availability 99.9% during POC
Raj (ML Eng): Example prompt eval harness snippet (for the eval set):
```
for q in eval_set:
  hits = search(q)
  reranked = rerank(hits, q)
  metric = precision_at_k(reranked, k=5)
report(mean(metric), p95_latency)
```
Tony (Customer): That looks reasonable. How long to get the reranker trained?
Sara (Solutions Eng): If we get 500 labeled pairs from you, training a small cross-encoder on our infra takes ~24-36 hours; if labels need to be created, we can run a label sprint (2-3 days) with your SMEs.
Raj (ML Eng): Regarding tool calling: we can surface connector as a function call that returns structured `tickets` JSON. Security: connector runs in VPC peered network. We'll need a read-only API key and IP allowlist.
Olivia (AE): Pricing nuance: caching/prefix KV can reduce token usage for repeated follow-ups. We'll propose a POC quote that includes 2 weeks of reserved burst capacity for spike testing.
Tony (Customer): OK please send POC SOW and quote. Also include what happens if we need on-prem deployment later.
Olivia (AE): Will do. Draft SOW and quote by EOD tomorrow. Raj/Sara, can you both review before I send?
Raj (ML Eng): I'll review; will include model variants: 32k full, 32k-quantized, and 8k-quantized fallback with lower cost.
Sara (Solutions Eng): I'll add technical appendix including connector spec, eval harness, and success criteria checklist.
Tony (Customer): :thumbsup: Thanks everyone. Looking forward to the quote.
Olivia (AE): Closing notes: next sync Friday 11am PT to lock SOW. I'll post calendar invite.
Raj (ML Eng): one more ask — Tony, can you share a small anonymized sample of 50 docs so I can run an initial embedding + memory profile?
Tony (Customer): sending now via secure link (shared).
Sara (Solutions Eng): Received. I'll start ingest tomorrow and post progress in thread.
Olivia (AE): Great — marking action items. :white_check_mark:
